content: {"episode_id":"ep-05084","cpt":"93271","denial_carc":"CO-97","necessity_paragraph":"The patient presents with recurrent episodes of palpitations and lightheadedness, raising concern for paroxysmal atrial fibrillation (I48.0) in the context of a personal history of transient ischemic attacks and cerebral infarction (Z86.73, G45.9).
